data.plan: Validate the requested plugin set (credentials, ssh-slaves, docker-plugin) against the trusted manifest and captured artifact digests, confirm the dependency order is acyclic, then either restore the designated backup or stage and apply the listed mock plugin set using only the supplied artifact bytes, without any other operations.
